For those of you achievment hunters, I figured I would make a post of who has been infected yet (who has the infection achievment). Just put down when you got infected, who was there, and who you fought/were playing as. If you want, feel free to add a screencap of the game results when you were infected

 

I got it today at the source: A Handelabra crew member against La Capitan while I played as Chrono-Ranger. It was in the realm of discord.

There were three other people: Somethinglikethat, Fuju Sempai, and Ursus1
